description: This file defines functions to create and load various configurations of the DETR object detection model, including different ResNet backbones, with options for panoptic segmentation and pretrained weights.

methods.name: _make_detr
methods.description: Creates a DETR model with specified backbone, dilation, number of classes, and mask options.

methods.name: detr_resnet50
methods.description: Creates a DETR ResNet-50 model, optionally pretrained, with optional postprocessing.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_dc5
methods.description: Creates a DETR ResNet-50 model with dilation in the last block, optionally pretrained.

methods.name: detr_resnet101
methods.description: Creates a DETR ResNet-101 model, optionally pretrained.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_dc5
methods.description: Creates a DETR ResNet-101 model with dilation in the last block, optionally pretrained.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_panoptic
methods.description: Creates a panoptic DETR ResNet-50 model with a confidence threshold, optionally pretrained.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_dc5_panoptic
methods.description: Creates a panoptic DETR ResNet-50 model with dilation, confidence threshold, optionally pretrained.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_panoptic
methods.description: Creates a panoptic DETR ResNet-101 model with confidence threshold, optionally pretrained.
